summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of CORRECTION PASS fixes for Rokadly app. All 11 test scenarios (P0, P1, P2, and regression) passed successfully. Verified day-lock UI, reopen gating, store/date sync, acceptance figures, error states, edit self-conflict, signed opening adjustment, voucher conditional, wording/colors, mobile responsive, and regression sanity. No critical issues found.
passed_tests: P0-1: Day-lock UI - Lock banner appears on all pages (/bills, /cash-count, /allocation, /expenses) with correct finalization info, all fields disabled, buttons show 'Day locked'
P0-2: Reopen gating - Reopen confirm button disabled until real reason typed (whitespace-only rejected), dialog closes without altering finalized day
P0-3: Store/date sync - Date changes update UI correctly (/cash-count heading shows correct date, print links on /reconciliation contain correct business_date parameter, no stale data)

P0-4: Acceptance figures - All values verified for Main Jewellers 2026-08-11 (Opening ₹50,000, Cash Receipts ₹49,700, Non-Cash ₹68,500, Cash Expenses ₹6,500, Expected Cash ₹92,700, Variance -₹300). Rokad Register matches (Expected ₹92,700, Actual ₹92,400, Variance -₹300)
P0-5: Error/retry states - LoadErrorState component verified with data-testid='load-error-state' and data-testid='retry-button', used across all data-loading pages
P1-6: Edit self-conflict - No duplicate warning when editing own bill (bill UI-4848 created and edited successfully, no warning banner appeared)
P1-7: Signed opening adjustment - MoneyInput accepts negative values (allowNegative prop, regex /^-?[0-9]*\.?[0-9]{0,2}$/), preview shows signed adjustment, approve button gated by reason
P2-8: Voucher conditional - Voucher No field appears only when 'With Voucher' selected, hidden for 'Without Voucher'

P2-9: Wording + colors - Bills summary shows 'Money received' (not 'Net settlement'), save/login buttons use sapphire-blue primary color (not ruby red), ruby reserved for pending/void/negative variance
P2-10: Mobile responsive - Layouts verified at 360x800 and 390x844, customer name/phone stack vertically, phone input full width, no clipped controls

TEST-11: Regression sanity - All 6 demo logins work (admin, manager1, manager2, accountant1, cashier1, cashier3), bill creation with split payments functional, reconciliation status dropdown works, no console errors

success_percentage.backend: Not tested (already green 68/68 per main agent)
